methods_quotes.q: Confirmed measles cases in the United States are reported by state and local health departments to CDC using a standard case definition
An outbreak of measles is defined as a chain of transmission of three or more confirmed cases.
Genotypes listed are those identified in a sample from the imported case or from a case that is epidemiologically linked to that importation.
